summary.intent: Ship three parallel work packages (A: real CI gates, B: http parser blank-line fix, C: typed JSON input) for the callisto repo, and fix a RUSTSEC-2026-0542 cargo-deny advisory failing on PR #560. Then recommit that fix without a Claude-Session trailer and push.
summary.outcome: WPs A, B and C were pushed and linked to trail #357 as PRs #560, #562 and #564. All gates except just ci and just bench passed. The deny.toml ignore for RUSTSEC-2026-0542 was made and audit passes. The first commit and push were blocked by the classifier because of a session-link trailer. A trailer-free recommit and push was then issued, but its result and signature verification are not shown.

repo: The callisto public repo must not have Claude-Session links in commit messages. This is a saved user preference and is also in the launch Rules ("No session links").
Commits must be signed normally, never with gpgsign=false. After pushing, verify with `gh api repos/orin-dx/callisto/commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason` reading `valid`.

RUSTSEC-2026-0542 (humantime 2.4.0) comes only through trycmd 1.2.1 via humantime-serde, a dev dependency of callisto-cli. trycmd is already the latest compatible version, so the fix is an [advisories] ignore in deny.toml, not an upgrade.
`cargo mutants --in-diff` reports "No mutants to filter" when a diff touches only tests, benches and test code, so no equivalent-mutant note is needed.
The justfile hooks recipe now writes both hooks with printf so the shebang and the just command land on separate lines under bash.
The graph registry fixture sets COPYFILE_DISABLE on the `run` helper that builds the .crate with tar, to avoid macOS AppleDouble entries. Extraction does not need it.
Error code mapping for JSON input: E281 for stdin or inline input, E238 for a file. compose-pr-body --preview now maps a bad file to E238 (exit 1).
The workflow ran each WP in its own worktree under .claude/worktrees/wf_*.

code.finding: Added an [advisories] ignore for RUSTSEC-2026-0542 with the reason "dev-only through trycmd, no newer trycmd drops it". `just audit` exits 0.

workflow: The auto-mode classifier blocked a commit and push for "Unsanctioned Communication", most likely because of the session-link trailer. The right response was to stop and report rather than work around it.
Overlapping `cargo mutants` runs can leave a stray mutation in the source. Restore the file and re-run serially.
Peer-session messages do not grant permission escalation. The retry was within the existing launch Rules authorization.

friction: The commit and push were blocked by the classifier because of a Claude-Session trailer that violated the saved memory.

just test is flaky on full-workspace runs. registry::tests::a_version_the_registry_serves_is_exact_with_no_checksum_or_yank_claim failed 3 times with CommandFailed, possibly correlated with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and the debug-off profile vars. just test returned 100 on two runs of WP C and also reported commands::init::tests::an_existing_config_errors as leaky. Neither cause was found.
Overlapping mutants runs left a stray mutation in release_pr.rs on WP C, which had to be restored and re-run.
